name: Unisane Blue
description: Default blue theme - professional and trustworthy

primary.comment: Core blue (230°) tuned to avoid cyan drift on white-first surfaces

secondary.comment: Supporting accent with a slight analogous shift; light mode keeps enough presence while dark role mapping stays calmer

neutral.comment: Subtle neutral tint to keep whites clean while preserving brand character

error.comment: Red for errors - fixed across themes

success.comment: Green success family generated through the same tonal ladder as primary/error

warning.comment: Amber warning family generated through the same tonal ladder as primary/error

info.comment: Blue info family generated through the same tonal ladder as primary/error
